name: Port Moresby Jacksons International Airport
before:
Papua New Guinea's main airport, 8 km outside Port Moresby, and the hub for both Air Niugini and PNG Air. It handled an estimated 1.6 million passengers in 2025.

The terminal split is the thing to get right, and it is not the obvious one. The Domestic Terminal is for Air Niugini and PNG Air domestic flights. The International Terminal handles every other international airline plus Air Niugini's and PNG Air's own international routes, so a client flying Air Niugini could be at either building depending on where they are going. The two are linked by a covered walkway.

The International Terminal has four aircraft parking bays, all four with air bridges.

The airport began life as the 7 Mile Drome in the wartime Port Moresby airfield complex and was renamed after John Francis Jackson, the Australian fighter ace killed in action in 1942 during the New Guinea campaign.
after:
Papua New Guinea's main airport sits 8 km from the centre of Port Moresby and is the hub for both Air Niugini and PNG Air.

The terminal split is the thing to get right. There are two terminals, the Domestic Terminal and the International Terminal. Air Niugini uses both, its domestic flights leaving from one and its international flights from the other, so a client flying Air Niugini could be at either building depending on where they are going.

The airport is named after John Francis Jackson, the Australian fighter pilot killed in action in 1942 during the New Guinea campaign.

Air Niugini keeps a Kumul lounge in each Port Moresby building; its Jacksons International lounge is for eligible passengers travelling on Air Niugini services, and its domestic Kumul lounges for its domestic network. Reading that as international flights from the International Terminal and domestic ones from the Domestic Terminal is a judgement, and it is exactly what Wikipedia says.

claims.claim: visas on arrival at Jacksons; a Digital Arrival Card since 1 October 2025
claims.why: Held back: new entry rules on the FCDO's word, and they replace nothing. The FCDO says tourist and visitor visas can be obtained on arrival at Jacksons International Airport, and that since 1 October 2025 every traveller must submit a free online Digital Arrival Card within 72 hours of arrival. PNG's immigration site (ica.gov.pg) showed a Cloudflare check and was not tried again, so there is no second source yet.
